verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing exposes a well-documented REST API (paymentInstruments, webhooks, transaction rules, relayed authorisation, disputes, 3DS) with extensive first-party docs, and an llms.txt file confirms machine-readable doc discovery for AI agents. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
